english.title: Driver of motor vehicle fail to proceed as directed by PC / Traffic Warden / Traffic Officer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving]_
(B)_[propelling]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), neglected or refused to proceed in or keep to a particular line of traffic when directed to do so by a

(C)_[constable]_
(D)_[traffic warden]_
(E)_[traffic officer]_

acting in the execution of

(F)_[his]_
(G)_[her]_

duty and for the time being engaged in the regulation of traffic in a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
